source: Jerusalem Post (syndication of WSJ report citing Kpler)
title: Iran's floating oil reserves, used for China sales, completely depleted, analysts say
primaryReport: Wall Street Journal, Oct 22, 2026, citing Kpler analysts (paywalled; JPost syndication used)
keyFacts: Floating tanker reserves near Malaysia/Singapore: ~90M barrels at peak, <1M by Oct 5, fully depleted by mid-October (Kpler)
Homayoun Falakshahi, Kpler crude head: 'There's no more oil to discharge to China anymore'
Iran oil sales = ~30-40% of government revenue (Falakshahi)
Chinese payments from past sales may take up to ~2 months to arrive
